channel_conventions.deck: Status 9n/Bn resolves to channel 1 for -L / -1 figs and channel 2 for -R / -2 figs (decks 3/4 use channels 3/4, figs -3/-4).
channel_conventions.pads: Status 9p resolves to channels 8/9 for -L/-R figs (decks 3/4 use 10/11).
channel_conventions.global: Explicit statuses 94/95/96 and B4/B5/B6 map to channels 5/6/7. Status bytes are authoritative over printed channel.
